remarks:
Tucked away in the rolling hills minutes from the lake life, dining, marinas, and year round attractions of Bemus Point, this extraordinary country property offers the rare combination of privacy, acreage, recreation, and endless potential. Welcome to this rare raised ranch set on nearly 7 picturesque acres in the heart of sought after Chautauqua County.

Surrounded by nature and peaceful countryside views, this property feels like your own private retreat while still being just a short drive to Chautauqua Lake, local restaurants, shopping, golf, snowmobile trails, wineries, and all the charm the Bemus Point area is known for. Chautauqua Lake is one of Western New York’s premier destinations for boating, fishing, recreation, and lake living.

Enjoy the beauty of three private ponds, open green space, mature trees, and your very own orchard creating a peaceful setting.  A wrap around driveway offers convenience and curb appeal, while the attached garage, workshop space, and barn provide room for hobbies, storage, animals, equipment, or outdoor toys.

Inside, the home features an inviting open floor plan filled with natural light and designed for comfortable everyday living and entertaining alike. The main living area flows seamlessly together, creating the perfect gathering space or cozy evenings at home. Offering 3 bedrooms, this home provides the flexibility buyers are searching for.

The first floor showcases a stunning oversized fireplace and massive additional living area with incredible potential. Easily finish this level to dramatically expand the home’s finished square footage, creating the perfect family room, guest suite, recreation space, home office, or in law setup. The possibilities are endless.

Whether you dream of hobby farming, homesteading, entertaining, outdoor recreation, or simply escaping the noise of everyday life, this property delivers the lifestyle buyers are searching for in today’s market. Located near Long Point State Park, snowmobile and outdoor recreation areas, and the vibrant lake communities surrounding Chautauqua Lake, this is a property where every season brings something special.
